intro.label: About Ramdhura
intro.heading: A Quiet Mountain Village Retreat
intro.lead: Ramdhura is a quiet mountain village near Barmaik in Kalimpong, West Bengal.
intro.body: Set amidst pine forests and open skies, it is a peaceful place of greenery, fresh air, mountain landscapes, and drifting mist. Far from crowded towns, it is a place to slow down, breathe, and unwind in nature.

experience.label: The Mountain Pace
experience.heading: The Ramdhura Experience
experience.subheading: A slower cadence of life shaped by the quiet rhythm of the hills.

items.title: Quiet Mornings
items.description: Wake to crisp mountain air, birdsong in the pine trees, and soft sunlight across the quiet valley.

items.title: Unhurried Afternoons
items.description: Spend gentle hours surrounded by pine forest paths, open skies, and passing mountain clouds.

items.title: Peaceful Evenings
items.description: Settle into peaceful evenings with wholesome home-style food and cool mountain air.

kanchenjunga.label: Himalayan Panoramas
kanchenjunga.heading: A 360° view of Kanchenjunga is a short walk away.
kanchenjunga.body: From a viewpoint just a short walk from our homestay, take in an unobstructed 360-degree panoramic view of Mount Kanchenjunga and surrounding mountain landscapes.
kanchenjunga.riverAndMist: The vantage point also overlooks the winding Teesta River valley below, surrounded by open skies and shifting mountain clouds.
kanchenjunga.note: A short walk from the homestay • No strenuous trekking required

image.alt: 360-degree panoramic view of Mount Kanchenjunga from the nearby walk in Ramdhura
image.description: Authentic view of Mount Kanchenjunga taken from the nearby viewpoint (short walk from property).
